description: Register an espresso or alternative preparation machine.

built_in_grinder_id.description: id of a grinder built into this machine (bean-to-cup / integrated grinder)

catalog_id.description: Optional — the maintenance catalog model this is (the `id` of a catalog row, e.g. rancilio-silvia), when it was registered from the catalog. Its maintenance then comes from that model's researched record. "none" says it is not in the catalog.

connected_device.description: Metadata mapping to smart hardware APIs

hardness_dh.description: Optional — the TOTAL hardness (GH) of the water this machine runs on, in °dH (German degrees; ppm as CaCO3 ÷ 17.85), as a test strip reports it. Picks the band of a maker's hardness table for descaling and filter life

prep_style.description: Preparation style. One of: espresso, filter, immersion, percolation. Only "espresso" is diagnosed by the dialing engine (G8) — anything else is recorded but never dialed, so do not guess this field.

prep_type.description: Preparation equipment type. One of: espresso_machine, lever_press, moka_pot, aeropress, french_press, v60_dripper, cold_brew. Lower snake_case.

tools.description: JSON or comma-separated tools, e.g., paper filters, flow control, metal mesh

name: register_machine
title: Register an espresso machine
